captions.detailed: An entry-level external-cable dropper seatpost, featuring a black outer post sleeve and a silver inner sliding tube. A black rubber boot covers the interface where the inner tube enters the outer sleeve. At the top of the inner tube is a two-bolt rail saddle clamp mechanism, and on the side of the lower outer sleeve, a visible bracket holds a pivoting cable actuation lever.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of an external-cable dropper seatpost. It must feature a black outer sleeve with a side-mounted cable actuation lever bracket, a silver inner sliding post, a protective rubber boot, and a two-bolt saddle clamp at the top.
captions.factory: The code constructs the dropper seatpost using multiple parts and a prismatic joint. The outer sleeve is modeled using a Cylinder primitive, with additional smaller cylinders and boxes representing the cable lever bracket. The inner post is constructed as a separate part using a silver-colored Cylinder, topped with Box and Cylinder primitives to form the saddle clamp assembly. The two parts are connected via a prismatic articulation joint along the vertical Z-axis.
